findings.severity: blocking for the Phase A gate
findings.title: Malformed RFC3339 calendar/time values are accepted
findings.requirement: Malformed Engine time must throw; never fall back to host clock.
findings.actual: The extracted unmodified helper returns 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z, 2026-02-29T00:00:00Z, and 2026-10-18T24:00:00Z. The digit-only shape check and finite Date.parse accept overflow dates/hour 24.
findings.impact: These invalid strings can reach both Docker event --since/--until arguments instead of failing at engineTime(). This violates the explicit review gate; it is not evidence of a live Engine emitting such timestamps or a new persistence failure.
findings.recommendation: Validate calendar and time ranges without allowing Date.parse normalization; retain the original validated RFC3339Nano string and the existing budgets/failure codes. Fixtures were not edited.
